items.fact: The campaign is split into five chapters and has 91 story missions in total.
Mission counts by chapter are 22, 11, 26, 25 and 7. Chapter 2 has 3 extra optional missions and Chapter 3 has 1.
Chapter 1 is set in the Leonida Keys, Chapter 2 in Port Gellhorn, and Chapters 3 to 5 mostly in Vice City. Chapter 2 ends with the mission "Checking Out", when the pair move to Vice City.
The two playable protagonists are Jason and Lucia. Chapter 1 is played solely as Jason, who works as a drug runner in the Keys.
Leonida has six regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.
One interactive map lists 1,075 places, including 25 banks, 43 illegal operations, 36 smash 'n' grabs, 13 garages and 4 safehouses.
There are 18 collectible card sets, and set sizes range from 12 to 36 cards. Vice City Flamingos has 24 and Vice City Club de Futbol has 30.
Collecting three cards in each of the five counties unlocks the Collectible Cards achievement. Cards can be sold, and one rare card near Key Lento sells for about $6,000.

Several Chapter 2 motel collectibles are missable because you lose access to the Starlet Motel after the chapter. They include Bryson Powers on the laundry room washer, Vicki in the reception bathroom and Victor Maravella in the cafeteria fridge.
Rob other criminals, such as fleeing crooks carrying loot bags. In Chapters 2 and 3, a criminal's haul is worth more than most robbery locations you can hit yourself.
Moses buys stolen cars with no tracker from Chapter 2. Randy buys higher-end cars from Chapter 3 and can pay more than $30,000 for one.
Bank vault robberies, unlocked near the end of Chapter 4, can pay up to $200,000 a job. Robbing one instantly gives a 4-star wanted level.
Treasure diving for Kenton unlocks after the Chapter 1 mission "Island Dreams". It pays around $2,600 per haul on shipwreck dives around the Leonida Keys.
Demolition races at Ambrosia Raceway pay over $3,000 on the oval track, and you win once all rivals are wrecked. Hunting for Bret and Pilot Pete's cocaine drops are other paid activities.
The game has 40 unique race locations. Entry and vehicle rental fees apply, but a win pays more than you spend.
Vehicles have trackers that affect whether you can sell them. Check a car's tracker and value with the WAiNK app before delivering it, because tracked cars can't be sold to Moses.
Randy's wish list has 18 high-end sports cars to steal.
Sell cars at a Pay 'n' Spray until you hit its daily limit of about three or four. Then sleep at a safehouse to reset the limit.
In Chapter 1, take Donnie's H&L .38 Revolver from his car trunk before you dispose of the car. The unique weapon can't be obtained afterward.
In Chapter 4, finish "Bad Driver!" before starting "Power Play". Killing Felipe pays $20,000 immediately, while sparing him leads to a follow-up mission that gives you his car.

The first patch, version 01.002.002, came out on November 23, 2026. It fixes crashes, autosaving, stuck weather, phone calls that failed to trigger, wanted levels that wouldn't clear, the gym deadlift bar, and partners not handing over bags to fences.
Before the patch, players reported autosaves failing or disappearing and losing hours of progress. Manual saving was the common advice.
The patch notes don't mention the first-person-view glitch or the Xbox glitch that unlocks 60fps, so both still worked right after the update.
